fields.title: The FDA approves Novo Nordisk's CagriSema by March 31, 2027
fields.text: The US Food and Drug Administration approves CagriSema (cagrilintide 2.4 mg / semaglutide 2.4 mg) for chronic weight management on or before March 31, 2027. Novo filed in December 2025 and expects a decision in the fourth quarter of 2026. No covers a complete response letter, or no decision by that date.
